crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by…
Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

translations.web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
translations.bsb: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
translations.kjv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
translations.asv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.
